meta.name: Curtain Rail
meta.notes: Primary fills the iris page curtain, CTAs, tags, active filters and tints every image mat; a 55% primary/ivory mix carries prices and accents so near-black or pastel brands stay readable on the umber ground.

issues: The off-screen add-to-cart toast stayed rendered and showed up as an empty 'Bekijk' pill floating in the middle of the page (desktop, mobile and catalog)
On desktop the 'Scroll' hint sat at top:50% on the right, directly behind the featured card, so it showed as a clipped ghost label
Without product photos, all 24 catalog cards and the lookbook rail used the exact same pleated placeholder, which reads like a wall of repeated template boxes
On mobile the hero was cramped: the featured card ran into the fixed badge and the counter, and the CTAs crowded the card
On mobile the featured card was only partly wide (max 26rem) and left a ragged edge
fixed: Toast is now visibility:hidden until it is triggered, so it no longer appears as a ghost (both pages)
Moved the Scroll hint to the bottom centre of the hero, between the badge and the counter, so it no longer collides with the featured card

Placeholder frames are now staged 'curtain' vignettes: a spotlight that moves left, centre or right per card, an accent or shadow tint on alternating cards, a floor shadow and a hairline footlight. A grid of them now has rhythm instead of looking like clones, and it follows the brand colours
Mobile hero: more bottom padding to clear the fixed chrome, a tighter gap, a headline size clamped for 375–960px, and a full-width featured card
